name: Fureai ~Kizu Darake no Shoujo o Amayakasu~
original_name: ふれあい ～傷だらけの少女を甘やかす～
source: You are a stressed out, miserable salaryman. One day a lawyer comes to tell you that your only aunt has died. She had a daughter, who had been abused by her from the time she was born. You take it upon yourself to care for this girl, healing both yourself and her in the process.
translation: 你是个压力重重、郁郁不得志的上班族。一天，律师告诉你唯一的姨母去世了。她有一个女儿，从出生起就一直遭受母亲虐待。于是你决定照顾这个女孩，也在这个过程中治愈彼此。
